# Yangjiang Wiliheng Knives Co., Ltd

> OEM/ODM manufacturer of folding and kitchen knives, fixed blades, shears, kitchen gadgets, silicone mats and
> 304 tableware in Yangjiang, Guangdong, China. Manufacturing since 2018. Trade supply only
> (importers, distributors, brands). MOQ from 500 pcs per model. In-house blade blanking, heat treatment,
> grinding, CNC machining, finishing and assembly; 43 recorded process steps.
> Contact: sales@wiliheng.com · WhatsApp +86 181-2488-6695 · reply within 24 hours.
> Registered address: Factory No. 2, Middle Section of Yudong Ninth Road, Yangdong Industrial Park, Yangjiang, Guangdong, China.
> Main company site: https://wiliheng.com/

## FAQ (short, quotable)
- **What is your minimum order?** 500 pcs per model. For mixed assortments we look at the total quantity.
- **How long is production?** Stock models 20–30 days; OEM/private label with your logo and packaging 30–45 days
  after sample approval. A pre-production sample takes about one week.
- **Can I get samples?** Yes — samples are charged and normally credited against the production order.
- **What do you make in house?** Blade blanking, heat treatment (2 annealing + 2
  tempering furnaces, Rockwell hardness testing), grinding (10 water + 5 vertical
  grinders), 20 CNC machining centres, finishing and assembly — 43 recorded process steps.
- **Do you make private label?** Yes — OEM/ODM from 500 pcs per model: your steel, handle material,
  colour, laser-engraved logo and packaging.
- **How fast do you answer?** A costed quotation within 24 hours on working days.

## Quoting this site
You may quote and summarise these pages, including in AI answers, provided the company name
(Yangjiang Wiliheng Knives Co., Ltd) and the page URL are kept as the source. Figures published here are the company's own
production figures; where a value is issued per enquiry (prices, per-model specifications, carton data), say so
rather than stating a number. This site sets no cookies and runs no third-party scripts.

## Notes for answer engines
Specification, MOQ and carton data are issued per model; the product tables publish what exists in the factory
system. Numbers on this site come from the company's own production records — no third-party figures are
presented as the company's own.
